title: Pricing the W7 merge+dedup oracle's 9,202 row deletions: real prize vs labeller flicker
status: registered before any W10 number existed
question: How much of the oracle_merge_dedup +4.4999 GS-HOTA (kb v10-w7-002), specifically its 9,202 GT-informed row deletions, is REAL reachable value for a future GT-free row-pruning stage, and how much is labeller-flicker artefact (kb v10-w7-005, v10-w9-002)?

scope.split: DEV-20 only (tools.gsr_v10_w5.DEV20); TEST/challenge untouched, no metric read on any test sequence
scope.compute: CPU only, cached artifacts only; no cluster, no GPU
scope.builds_nothing: measure-only. No shipped stage is created or modified. The tolerant matcher is instrument-side (evaluation layer) and never enters a submission.

premise_under_test.from_kb: v10-w7-002 prices merge+dedup at +4.4999 (DetA +3.5048); the brief attributes DetA +3.50 to the 9,202 deletions.
premise_under_test.already_on_record: oracle_dedup -- the SAME 9,202 rows removed with ids untouched -- is worth +0.5261 GS-HOTA / +0.7718 DetA (results/gsr_benchmark/gsr_v10_w7.json). This session must state plainly if the decomposition contradicts the brief's premise.

section_1_decomposition.drop_set: Re-derived exactly as tools.gsr_v10_w7.apply_merges(mode='merge_dedup'): per (owner GT id, frame) group keep the highest-confidence row, delete the rest. Self-check: the re-derived set must total 9,202 rows.
section_1_decomposition.row_label: gt_id from tools.gsr_v9_factory.label_rows (nearest GT player/GK within eval.gsr_score.GSR_DIST_TOL_M = 5.0 m; -1 otherwise). Track owner = tools.gsr_v10_w7.ownership dominant vote at >= 5 audited rows.

buckets.junk: gt_id == -1: the row matches no GT within 5 m
buckets.dup_owner: gt_id == owner: a genuine duplicate-match competition lost to a better row of the same GT in the same frame
buckets.wrong_stable: gt_id >= 0 and != owner, inside a disagreement run of >= 25 audited rows (1 s at 25 fps)
buckets.wrong_mid: same, run of 6..24 rows (reported, claimed by neither category)
buckets.wrong_flicker: same, run of <= 5 audited rows (the W7 flicker convention, kb v10-w7-005)
buckets.no_owner: the track carries no trusted dominant identity (residual, expected ~0)

section_1_decomposition.run_definition: Maximal consecutive run, over the track's frame-sorted AUDITED rows, of rows disagreeing with the track owner (the tools.gsr_v10_w7.flicker_anatomy convention). Unaudited rows are transparent.

section_2_tolerant.matcher: A dropped row whose claimed GT g' differs from the owner is re-read as owner-consistent when the two GT players are within 1.5 m of each other IN THAT FRAME. Disagreement runs are recomputed on the tolerant flags, so a 'stable' wrong-identity run can collapse to flicker or vanish.
section_2_tolerant.unverifiable: If the owner GT is absent from the frame the row stays strictly wrong; the count is reported.
section_2_tolerant.layer: EVALUATION/instrument side only. Scoring is always the official evaluator, unmodified.

section_1_2_counterfactuals.axis_A_prune_only: Baseline = arm D untouched. Arm = arm D with exactly one bucket's rows deleted, NO id change. This is what a future GT-free row pruner could actually do, and it is the axis the verdict prices.
section_1_2_counterfactuals.axis_B_in_oracle: Baseline = arm D with merge-all applied and NO deletion. Arm = merge-all plus exactly one bucket's deletions. This decomposes the oracle's +4.4999 rather than the pruning axis.
section_1_2_counterfactuals.scoring: tools.gsr_v9_w7.score_pair, official evaluator, full flag stack (flags ON and OFF), 20 clips, paired Wilcoxon.
section_1_2_counterfactuals.self_check: axis A with ALL 9,202 rows must reproduce the on-record oracle_dedup delta (+0.5261 ON / +0.3038 OFF) to within 0.01.

section_3_signal_audit.population: rows deleted in the SURVIVING buckets vs all kept arm-D rows
features: distance to own track's local path centroid (median position over +/- 12 frames)
local track density (other tracks within 2 m in the frame)
nearest other predicted row in the frame (metres)
max image-box IoU with another track's box in the frame
per-frame calibration residual (v10-W2 gate cache solver error_m)
image box height in px (scale/depth proxy)
section_3_signal_audit.statistic: rank AUC per feature (Mann-Whitney U / n1 n2). NO model is trained -- separability only.

section_4_verdict_rule.prize: The flicker-robust REACHABLE prize = axis-A GS-HOTA delta (flags ON) of the UNION of the qualifying buckets under tolerant bucketing. Qualifying = junk, dup_owner, wrong_stable. Flicker (and, being undefined without GT, wrong_mid) does not qualify.
section_4_verdict_rule.bar: >= +1.5 GS-HOTA -> recommend registering a row-pruning session naming the separating signals; < +1.5 -> the axis is CLOSED and the association story ends at 'GT noise dominates the residual', stated as a thesis claim.
